title.narrative: Hunan Xiangxi Rural Environmental Improvement and Green Development Project

description.narrative:
The Asian Development Bank (ADB) and the government have agreed to adopt a framework approach to support the plan, with a focus on: (i) institutional strengthening and policy reform; (ii) ecosystem restoration and environmental protection; (iii) green industrial transformation; and (iv) construction of an integrated multimodal transport corridor.
The project is included in the country operations business plan for the People's Republic of China, 2019-2021

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Local-featured ecological agricultural and forestry products developed Indicator: By 2027, 3,961 new job opportunities for construction and operation created by the construction and operation of the four bases for the development of local-featured ecological agricultural and forestry products, of which at least 35% are provided to women (2020 baseline: Not applicable) Achievement: 12 Progress/Status: In progress. Data Source: Project progress reports and/or external resettlement and social development M&E reports

Output: Local-featured ecological agricultural and forestry products developed Indicator: By 2027, 7,150 farmers and 140 technicians, of which at least 40% are women, have been trained and have reported their improved knowledge on technologies for local-featured ecological agricultural and forestry products Achievement: 531 Progress/Status: In progress. Data Source: Post-training surveys to obtain feedback on participants' learning

Output: Rural waste and sanitation management facilities and services improved Indicator: By 2024, 85 rural garbage management teams formed in the project area, of which at least 30% are led by women Achievement: 64 Progress/Status: In progress. Data Source: Project progress reports and/or external resettlement and social development M&E reports

Output: Rural waste and sanitation management facilities and services improved Indicator: By 2027, 1,391 new job opportunities for construction and operation created, of which at least 35% are provided to women Achievement: 252 Progress/Status: In progress. Data Source: Project progress reports and/or external resettlement and social development M&E reports

Output: Rural waste and sanitation management facilities and services improved Indicator: By 2027, 36,600 residents (of which 45% are women) trained and reported their improved knowledge on garbage classification and recycling Achievement: 7877 Progress/Status: In progress. Data Source: Post-training surveys to obtain feedback on participants' learning

Output: Value added to local products through value chains and ecotourism Indicator: By 2026, about 1,577 new job opportunities for construction and operation created by the construction and operation of the value chain facilities and the ecotourism resources and facilities, of which at least 30% are provided to women Achievement: 318 Progress/Status: In progress. Data Source: Project progress reports and/or external resettlement and social development M&E reports

Output: Value added to local products through value chains and ecotourism Indicator: By 2027, 300 farmers and 354 staff members, including technicians, and 103 management staff members of government agencies, of which at least 40% are women, have been trained and have reported their enhanced knowledge on value addition to local-featured ecological agricultural and forestry products Achievement: 4355 Progress/Status: In progress. Data Source: Post-training surveys to obtain feedback on participants' learning

Output: Local-featured ecological agricultural and forestry products developed Indicator: By 2027, 147 quality certificates issued for local-featured ecological agricultural and forestry products in Xiangxi Achievement: 124 Progress/Status: In progress. Data Source: Reports by the XPG

Output: Value added to local products through value chains and ecotourism Indicator: By 2027, number of tourists per year to rural areas in Xiangxi increased to 40.0 million Achievement: 61.7 Progress/Status: In progress. Data Source: Reports by the XPG

Output: Rural waste and sanitation management facilities and services improved Indicator: By 2024, 504 tons per day of solid waste from 87,530 households (including 335,078 people, of which 161,496 are women) in the project area connected with garbage treatment (2020 baseline: 211 tons per day from 58,580 households [including 222,630 people, of which 107,296 are women]) Achievement: 265 Progress/Status: In progress. Data Source: Surveys by village committees

Output: Rural waste and sanitation management facilities and services improved Indicator: By 2024, 45,826 households (including 183,511 people, of which 88,452 are women) in the project area connected with wastewater facilities (2020 baseline: 22,972 households [including 91,647 people, of which 44,174 are women]) Achievement: 27617 Progress/Status: In progress. Data Source: Surveys by village committees

Output: Rural waste and sanitation management facilities and services improved Indicator: By 2024, households that have sanitary toilets increased to 62,929 (including 241,058 people, of which 116,200 are women) in the project area (2020 baseline: 57,469 households [including 218,672 people, of which 105,400 are women]) Achievement: 62944 Progress/Status: In progress. Data Source: Surveys by village committees

Output: Local-featured ecological agricultural and forestry products developed Indicator: By 2027, facilities for the development of local-featured ecological agricultural and forestry products operational in four locations within Xiangxi (2020 baseline: Not applicable) (OP 1.3.1; OP 5.1.1; OP 5.3) Achievement: N Progress/Status: In progress. Data Source: Project progress reports Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y Actual value: N

Output: Value added to local products through value chains and ecotourism Indicator: By 2027, facilities to improve value chains and promote ecotourism constructed under the project and related services operational to add value to local-featured ecological agricultural and forestry products Achievement: N Progress/Status: In progress. Data Source: Project progress reports Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y Actual value: N
